assumptions.cohort: 100 users, each completes one conversation in one UTC day
assumptions.history_per_prior_turn: 60 user tokens + final answer tokens + one 50-token tool-call message and 120-token tool result per configured tool loop
assumptions.tool_loop_semantics: Each loop adds one sequential LLM follow-up call; repeat static context and history on every request; each earlier tool-call/result pair adds 170 input tokens to later calls. Tool execution itself is deterministic and has no model-token cost.
assumptions.answer_tokens: 250 or 500 final-answer tokens per user turn; each tool-loop call emits 50 tokens before the final answer.
assumptions.onboarding: buttons = no LLM call; llm = one bounded call/user with 600 input and 120 output tokens.
assumptions.cached_input: No prompt-cache discount assumed; all input priced at uncached rates.
assumptions.models_and_rates: Only listed public prices/quotas; no hidden concurrency, SLA, or throughput inferred.
assumptions.latency: Unknown. No endpoint calls or load tests were performed; model-directory tokens/second are not converted to end-to-end response latency.
assumptions.financial_data: Profile is treated only as a token-count component; no personal financial details or real user data are generated or sent.

edge_cases.expected_handling: Stop inference when the shared free budget is exhausted; deterministic fallback, no paid upgrade without approval.
Bounded FIFO queue with shared global limits; lower bound is quota arithmetic, not completion-time prediction.
Do not retry in a tight loop; honor Retry-After if supplied, jittered backoff, then fallback/queue.
Expose latency as unknown until endpoint tests collect p50/p95; no synthetic latency value.

fairness_policy.identity: Per authenticated account or signed anonymous session; never rely on source IP as the sole quota key.
fairness_policy.shared_networks: Treat NAT/shared-IP bursts as one network signal only; do not pool or revoke the per-user allowance because users share an IP.
fairness_policy.allocation: Reserve 10% of the published free daily cap for service overhead; divide the other 90% equally across 100 active users and debit by actual tokens/Neurons and requests.
fairness_policy.global_control: One account-global atomic counter and queue per provider/model, honoring documented RPM/TPM/RPD/TPD/Neuron limits. No multi-account/key quota splitting.
fairness_policy.fallback: When a user's fair share or the global free quota is exhausted, pause AI for that user and show deterministic catalog search, calculator, FAQ or an explicit unavailable message.

limitations: Quota arithmetic is not a measurement of throughput, concurrency or latency.
No calls to provider APIs, accounts, keys, payments or external load were used.
Groq limits are public free-plan reference values and vary by organization; Cloudflare publishes no TPM or concurrency guarantee for the modeled standard text generation path.
Tool loops are modeled token/request overhead; native function-calling support for Cloudflare Llama 3.2 3B is not listed on its model page, so its tool integration is unverified.
No exchange-rate conversion; zero-euro recommendation means no paid spend, not that any paid USD list-price amount converts to a particular EUR value.
